description: Excavations revealed part of what is believed to be a Romano-Celtic temple, limited dating evidence suggests 2nd CE activity. A possible votive pit was found inside the cella, this contained (possibly) seeds and mice bones, but it seems likely these date from after the temple was abandoned.
bibliography: Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “Boxted, Upchurch (Kent).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
